items.title: Customs detention notice: Structural steel imports without IS 2062 FMCS license
items.summary: Customs at JNPT Mumbai detaining shipments of structural steel lacking valid IS 2062 FMCS license. Importers must secure licenses before departure.

items.title: Bilateral MRA with European Union expanded to include safety equipment
items.summary: India-EU Technical Cooperation Agreement now covers IS 4151 helmets and IS 2082 water heaters, allowing EU test reports for FMCS applications.

items.title: FMCS license renewal: Annual audit schedule published
items.summary: BIS has published the factory audit schedule for FMCS renewal applicants. Foreign manufacturers must respond within 30 days.

items.title: CRS registration mandatory for all imported IT equipment
items.summary: MeitY has notified that all imported IT equipment under IS 13252 must complete CRS registration before customs clearance. Effective immediately for new shipments.

items.title: Lab recognition scheme 2026 list published
items.summary: Updated list of Group-1 recognised and Group-2 empanelled laboratories released.

items.title: New QCO on structural steel enforcement
items.summary: Quality Control Order for hot rolled structural steel IS 2062 now in force.

items.title: CRS registration deadline for LED lamps
items.summary: Manufacturers of self-ballasted LED lamps must complete CRS registration by notified date.

items.title: Mandatory hallmarking expanded to 256 districts
items.summary: Phase-wise mandatory hallmarking now covers additional districts as per latest order.

items.title: Updated product manuals published
items.summary: Product manuals for helmet, bicycle frame and clinical thermometer updated on the portal.

items.title: Webinar on Technical Regulation Portal
items.summary: Open session for MSMEs on using the BIS technical regulation portal.

items.title: Extension of amendments to Indian Standards
items.summary: BIS has extended the effective date for selected amendments under Scheme-I.
